steps: Sign in to developer.paypal.com and switch the toggle to Live (use the 'paypal-sandbox' recipe for Sandbox keys)
Open Apps & Credentials and create an app (or open yours)
Copy the Client ID, then click Show under Secret and copy it
unverified: validate.auth.token_url (PayPal's docs show the sandbox host; the live host is the usual one but is not shown there)

least_privilege.summary: Create a separate live app for this project with only the features it needs.
